description: A close-up exterior vignette at dusk, focused on the corner of a contemporary building clad in large-format coursed grey stone tiles with clean mortar joints. On the stone face just left of center, a dark matte-finished circular disc-shaped outdoor wall fixture is mounted, directing a concentrated warm amber beam downward and slightly onto the stone surface — the light creating a dramatic glow pattern on the stone below and around the fixture. The warm light contrasts strikingly against the cool stone and the deep blue-grey dusk sky. To the right, the edge of a large-format window system with slim dark frame profiles is visible — through the glass, the fading orange-pink sunset sky is reflected. The ground plane below is not visible. The composition is tight and graphic — a close architectural detail shot that emphasizes the texture of the stone and the quality of the light cast. Camera is at a slightly elevated or standing eye-level position with a normal to slightly telephoto lens, framing the corner in a vignette composition off-center to the left. The mood is dramatic and minimal. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
